description: Java class implementing a service module for Verisign PayFlow Pro payment processing, including methods for authorization, capture, void, refund, and PayPal express checkout integration, with detailed response parsing and configuration handling.

classes.name: PayflowPro
classes.description: Service class providing payment processing methods for credit card authorization, capture, void, refund, and PayPal express checkout integration using PayFlow Pro API.

methods.name: ccProcessor
methods.description: Handles credit card authorization, supporting PayPal and card payments, constructs request data, sends transaction, and processes response.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction, sending capture request and parsing response.

methods.name: ccVoid
methods.description: Voids a transaction, sending void request and parsing response.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a captured transaction, with response parsing.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Initiates a PayPal express checkout, requesting a token and redirect URL, and storing token in cart.

methods.name: getExpressCheckout
methods.description: Completes an express checkout by retrieving checkout details, creating payment method, and updating cart.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Finalizes a PayPal express checkout by executing payment and updating payment method.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses response string into key-value map.

methods.name: parseAuthResponse
methods.description: Parses authorization response, determines success, and sets result flags.

methods.name: parseCaptureResponse
methods.description: Parses capture response and sets success flags.

methods.name: parseVoidResponse
methods.description: Parses void response and sets success flags.

methods.name: parseRefundResponse
methods.description: Parses refund response and sets success flags.

methods.name: parseContext
methods.description: Converts context map into unencoded name=value string for request.

methods.name: makeBaseParams
methods.description: Builds base request parameters from configuration for PayFlow API.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes PayFlow API client with configuration parameters.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration value for payment gateway, from entity or properties.

methods.name: comparePaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Compares configuration value with expected string.

methods.name: addCartDetails
methods.description: Adds shopping cart details to request parameters for PayPal express checkout.
